UNIVERSITY INSTITUTE OF LAWS
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, REGIONAL CENTRE LUDHIANA
ADVERTISEMENT FOR THE FACULTY POSITIONS IN THE SUBJECT
OF LAW
Faculty positions No. of
seats
Honorarium Duration*
Guest Faculty (Law) 01 Rs. 1500/- per lecture
subject to maximum of
Rs. 50,000/- per month
(subject to PU Rules)
Odd Semester of
session 2026-27
Minimum Qualification is as per UGC/P.U norms.
https://www.ugc.gov.in/pdfnews/5323630_New_Draft_UGCRegulation-2018-9-
2.pdf )
Applicants are advised to send/submit hard copy of their applications to the Director,
University Institute of Laws, Panjab University Regional Centre, Ludhiana along with all
self- attested copies of their certificates and other relevant documents including
publications for verification along with the duly filled application form and template pages
1 to 11
https://forms.puchd.ac.in/forms/20200122155429-
directrecruitmentassistantprofessorapplicationformasperugcregulation2018.pdf)
on or before 10th September, 2026 till 4:00 p.m.
Late applications will not be considered and will stand rejected.
Important Instructions:
1. At the time of interview physical presence of the candidate is mandatory. The
candidates are required to bring all the supporting
documents /certificates /publications in original.
2. Two sets of the duly filled-in form, along with the documents duly attested by the candidate, may
be submitted either by post or by hand on or before the prescribed date.
3. Candidates shortlisted will be intimated about the date and timings for the interview by email
only. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
4. The candidates who had submitted the form and documents either by post or by hand need to
bring the hard copies of the form and the self-attested documents at the time
of Interview.
Sd/-
Director
P.U. Regional Centre, Ludhiana
